senses.gloss: क्लिन्न-पक्ष- + उत्तर क्लिन्न-पक्ष- + उत्तर, adj. of which the upper parts of the wings are wet, Daśak. 1, 16.

क्लिद् क्लिद्, i. 4, क्लिद्य, Par. To become wet, Suśr. 2, 23, 12.
 क्लिन्न,
 1. Wet, Rām. 1, 42, 20.
 2. Filled with tears.
 3. Compassionate, Bhāg. P. 4, 3, 10.
 --Caus. क्लेदय, To make wet, Bhag. 2, 23.
 --With the prep. समा सम्-आ, समाक्लिन्न, Wet with tears, MBh. 3, 13472.
 --With परि परि, परिक्लिन्न, Completely wet, Rām. 4, 6, 16.
 --With प्र प्र, Ātm. To become wet, Suśr. 1, 297, 17.
 प्रक्लिन्न, Wet, Rām. 3, 22, 21.
 --Caus. To moisten, Suśr. 1, 68, 4.
 --With वि वि, विक्लिन्न, Thoroughly wet, MBh. 1, 5412.
 --With सम् सम्, संक्लिन्न, Wet, Mṛcch. 92, 7.
 --Cf. perhaps κλύδιος, κλύζω; Goth. hlûtrs, etc.

† क्लिन्द् क्लिन्द्, i. 1, Par., Ātm. To bewail.
 --Cf. क्रन्द्.

क्लिश् क्लिश्, ii. 9, क्लिश्ना, क्लिश्नी, Par., and i. 4, क्लिश्य, Ātm. (also Par. Man. 8, 169),
 1. To torment. MBh. 2, 2351; Ragh. 13, 73.
 2. i. 4. To suffer distress, MBh. 2, 2255, Man. 8, 169.
 क्लिष्ट,
 1. Afflicted, Śāk. d. 58, Rām. 3, 58, 15.
 2. Hurt, Rām. 3, 58, 12.
 3. Wasted, Suśr. 2, 157, 8.
 4. Painful, Pañc. i. d. 12.
 टम्, adv. Miserably, Bhāg. P. 1, 9, 12.
 --Comp.
 --Caus. क्लेशय, To torment, Rām. 5, 27, 33.
 --With उद् उद्, To become uneasy, Suśr. 1, 331, 21.
 --Caus. To stir, Suśr. 2, 184, 18.
 --With समुद् सम्-उद्, To become uneasy, Suśr. 2, 348, 18.
 --With परि परि,
 1. To torment, Rām. 5, 58, 21.
 2. i. 4, To suffer distress, Rām. 5, 25, 32; Par. MBh. 3, 578.
 परिक्लिष्ट, Much pained, Rām. 3, 52, 41.
 टम्, adv. With pain, Bhag. 17, 21.
 अ-, adv. With cheerfulness, MBh. 3, 108.
 --With वि वि, विक्लिष्ट, Violated, Rām. 4, 17, 15.
 --With सम् सम्, To torment, Rām. 2, 22, 14.
 संक्लिष्ट, Bruised, Suśr. 2, 16, 17.
 --Cf. कृश् and लिश्.

† क्लीब् क्लीब् and क्लीव् क्लीव्, i. 1. Ātm.
 1. To behave like an eunuch; to be timorous.

क्लीब क्लीब, or क्लीव क्लीव, adj.
 1. Deprived of virility; m. An eunuch, Man. 3, 150.
 2. Timorous; m. A coward, MBh. 1, 5142.
 3. Neuter.
 --Comp.

क्लीबता क्लीब + ता, f. and क्लीबत्व क्लीब-त्व, n.
 1. Want of virility, Suśr. 1, 366, 8.
 --Comp.
